plate_comment: Initializes the 48RE shift logic: transmission_vehicle_inertia = transmission_vehicle_inertia_default (e2m RE_Inertia_Default), the predicted post-shift acceleration 0, the anti-hunt and low range shift flags cleared, fourth_gear_tcc_lockup_boost_input = the intake manifold pressure, and every governor pressure / shift table lookup cache set to 2 (the first segment) (was mpc555_initProtectionFilterVariables)
